                                                      UP YOUR GAME




  Watch a skilled player on Twitch.tv and practice
assessing all ranges involved when an overbet takes
place. Overbets have the potential to turn into an
expensive mistake when used at the wrong time, so you
must learn to assess ranges accurately before attempting
the concept yourself. Both you and your opponent must
have a strong range, but yours must be stronger.
